fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped: H2 combustion + flue-gas energy balance + boiler thermal-mass ODE
source: Turns (2012) An Introduction to Combustion, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill (H2 combustion, adiabatic flame temp, LHV/HHV); Cellek & Pinarbasi (2018) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 43, 1194-1207 (H2 flame temp & NOx); Hy4Heat WP6 (2021) BEIS UK; Woolley et al. (2022) Appl. Energy 323, 119577; NIST-JANAF thermochemical tables (cp values, h_fg of water).

unit.name: Generic 30 kW Domestic/Light-Commercial 100% Hydrogen Condensing Boiler

Q_rated.note: Rated useful thermal output to water

LHV_H2_MJ_kg.note: Lower heating value of H2 (Turns 2012, Table A; water in products as vapour)

HHV_H2_MJ_kg.note: Higher heating value of H2 (Turns 2012; water condensed). HHV-LHV = latent heat of product water -> high condensing potential

AFR_stoich.note: Stoichiometric air-fuel mass ratio: 2 H2 + O2 -> 2 H2O; 1 kg H2 needs 8 kg O2 = 34.3 kg air (O2 mass frac 0.233)

excess_air_ratio.note: Lambda; lean operation moderates flame temp & thermal-NOx (Cellek & Pinarbasi 2018)

cp_water.note: Specific heat of liquid water at ~50C (NIST)

cp_flue.note: Mass-weighted cp of H2O-rich + N2 flue gas at ~400-800K (NIST-JANAF; H2O cp~2.0, N2 cp~1.1 kJ/kgK)

cp_H2.note: Specific heat of H2 gas at ~300K (NIST)

h_fg_water.note: Latent heat of vaporisation of water at 25C (NIST); recoverable in condensing mode

m_water.note: Lumped water + heat-exchanger thermal mass (water-equivalent) in boiler

T_adiabatic_flame_K.note: Approx adiabatic flame temp of lean H2/air (lambda~1.25); ~150-200K hotter than CH4 -> elevated thermal NOx risk (Cellek & Pinarbasi 2018)

T_flue_noncond_K.note: Stack exit temp, non-condensing (70C, above ~58C H2 dew point)

T_flue_cond_K.note: Stack exit temp, condensing (45C, below dew point -> latent recovery)

T_dew_K.note: Flue dew point ~58C; high because H2 products are ~100% H2O (higher H2O mole fraction than NG)

condensation_fraction.note: Fraction of product water condensed in condensing mode at design return temp

hA_load.note: UA of heat emitter / load loop (water -> heating circuit)

T_return_K.note: Heating-circuit return water temp (40C); condensing requires low return temp

hA_standby.note: Casing standby loss UA to ambient
